title: Custom Software
seoTitle: What Is Custom Software? When It Beats Off-the-Shelf
seoDescription: Custom software is built for your specific processes instead of bought ready-made. When it makes sense, costs in India, ownership and how to reduce risk.
summary: Custom software is built specifically for one business's processes, users and systems, rather than bought as a ready-made product. It fits how you work and can connect deeply to your other tools, at the cost of higher upfront investment and the need for a reliable development partner.

dataPoints.label: Makes sense when
dataPoints.value: Your process is a competitive advantage, packaged tools need heavy workarounds, or per-user fees grow large

dataPoints.label: Ownership
dataPoints.value: Agree in writing that you own the code, data and hosting accounts

dataPoints.label: Risk reducers
dataPoints.value: Discovery phase, phased delivery, UAT, documentation, handover clause

body:
## Build, buy or extend

Many businesses do best with a mix: packaged tools for standard functions such as accounting, and custom software for the process that makes them different. See [build, buy or extend](/blog/build-buy-or-extend-choosing-software-for-a-100-person-company).

## Costs

Cost depends on users, workflows, integrations and quality requirements. See [custom software development costs in India](/blog/how-much-does-custom-software-development-cost-in-india-in-2026).

faqs.q: Is custom software only for large companies?
faqs.a: No. Small, focused internal tools are often the highest-return custom software for SMEs.

faqs.q: What happens if the developer leaves?
faqs.a: With documented code in your own repository and a handover clause, another team can take over.
